selection: A study is included when any listed term occurs at least once in its title, abstract, or keywords, using the NeuroQuery 156,521-term count features. All of that study's reported coordinates are used.

activities.title: Watching films
activities.description: Studies that describe movies or film clips, including naturalistic viewing and films used to evoke emotions.

activities.title: Listening to music
activities.description: Studies about music, from listening and musical training to melody, harmony, and musical emotion.

activities.title: Seeing faces
activities.description: Studies about viewing or recognizing faces, often including emotional expressions.

activities.title: Viewing scenes and places
activities.description: Studies about viewing scenes, landscapes, and buildings.

activities.title: Seeing motion
activities.description: Studies about perceiving moving visual stimuli.

activities.title: Hearing voices
activities.description: Studies about human voices, including vocal identity and emotion. Some also study voice-hearing experiences.

activities.title: Finding things beautiful
activities.description: Studies about aesthetic judgments and beauty in faces, art, music, and other stimuli.

activities.title: Feeling pain
activities.description: Studies about painful stimulation, pain perception, and some chronic pain conditions.

activities.title: Touch
activities.description: Studies about touch and tactile stimulation of the skin.

activities.title: Taste
activities.description: Studies about tastes and flavors delivered to the mouth.

activities.title: Smell
activities.description: Studies about odors and the sense of smell.

activities.title: Food and hunger
activities.description: Studies about food cues, eating, appetite, and hunger.

activities.title: Sensing the inner body
activities.description: Studies about sensing internal bodily signals, such as heartbeat or breathing.

activities.title: Reading
activities.description: Studies about reading words, sentences, and text, including reading development and dyslexia.

activities.title: Listening to speech
activities.description: Studies about hearing and understanding spoken language.

activities.title: Speaking
activities.description: Studies about producing speech aloud or preparing to speak.

activities.title: Understanding word meaning
activities.description: Studies about meaning in words, concepts, and semantic knowledge.

activities.title: Grammar and sentence structure
activities.description: Studies about syntax and building sentence structure.

activities.title: Following stories
activities.description: Studies about stories and narratives, read or heard.

activities.title: Sign language
activities.description: Studies about producing or understanding signed languages.

activities.title: Anger
activities.description: Studies about anger, often using angry faces or provocation tasks.

activities.title: Fear
activities.description: Studies about fear, including fearful faces, threat, and fear learning.

activities.title: Sadness
activities.description: Studies about sadness, sad faces, and sad mood induction.

activities.title: Happiness
activities.description: Studies about happiness, often using happy faces or positive mood induction.

activities.title: Disgust
activities.description: Studies about disgust, from disgusting images to disgusted faces.

activities.title: Anxiety
activities.description: Studies about anxiety states, anxious traits, and anxiety disorders.

activities.title: Getting a reward
activities.description: Studies about expecting or receiving rewards, often money.

activities.title: Humor and laughter
activities.description: Studies about finding things funny, jokes, and laughter.

activities.title: Craving
activities.description: Studies about craving, often for drugs, alcohol, nicotine, or food.

activities.title: Calming emotions
activities.description: Studies about regulating emotions, especially by reappraising a situation.

activities.title: Holding information in mind
activities.description: Studies about working memory: briefly keeping and using information.

activities.title: Remembering past events
activities.description: Studies about episodic and autobiographical memory and retrieving memories.

activities.title: Mental arithmetic
activities.description: Studies about calculation and arithmetic problems.

activities.title: Making decisions
activities.description: Studies about choosing between options, value, and risk.

activities.title: Stopping an action
activities.description: Studies about cancelling or withholding a planned response.

activities.title: Focusing attention
activities.description: Studies about directing attention to locations, objects, or features.

activities.title: Imagining pictures
activities.description: Studies about creating mental images without seeing them.

activities.title: Finding your way
activities.description: Studies about spatial navigation in real or virtual environments.

activities.title: Being creative
activities.description: Studies about creative thinking and generating new ideas.

activities.title: Understanding others' minds
activities.description: Studies about inferring other people's beliefs, intentions, and mental states.

activities.title: Empathy
activities.description: Studies about sharing or understanding another person's feelings, often their pain.

activities.title: Thinking about yourself
activities.description: Studies about self-referential judgments, such as whether a word describes you.

activities.title: Moral judgment
activities.description: Studies about judging right and wrong and moral dilemmas.

activities.title: Lying
activities.description: Studies about telling lies or deceiving others.

activities.title: Finger tapping
activities.description: Studies about repeated finger movements.

activities.title: Moving the eyes
activities.description: Studies about saccades and other eye movements.

activities.title: Grasping
activities.description: Studies about grasping objects, performed or observed.

activities.title: Imagining movement
activities.description: Studies about imagining a movement without performing it.

activities.title: Watching others move
activities.description: Studies about observing other people's actions.

activities.title: Imitating
activities.description: Studies about copying another person's movements or expressions.

activities.title: Walking
activities.description: Studies about walking and gait, usually imagined or simulated in the scanner.

activities.title: Sleep and sleep loss
activities.description: Studies about sleep stages, sleep deprivation, and sleep disorders.

activities.title: Meditation
activities.description: Studies about meditation practice and mindfulness.
